title: BI 1291583 (AIRTIVITY, Study 1397-0018) – NDA Scenario Analysis & Adolescent Recruitment Mitigation

background.text: Three NDA scenarios are defined based on timing of adolescent vs adult recruitment completion and sufficiency of adolescent data at DBL1.
background.quote:
Scenario #1 (Global Goal):
Adolescent and adult recruitment completes simultaneously; and the labelled population includes 12 year and older patients with BE (no sNDA).

background.text: Scenario 2: Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult; available adolescent data at DBL1 may or may not be sufficient, with medium-to-high risk of sNDA; mitigation is China contributing more adolescent and CF patients.
background.quote:
Medium to high risk of sNDA, depending on the data totality;
China HA may have objections as well

background.text: Scenario 3: Adolescent data at DBL1 is NOT sufficient; sNDA required; China priority review and NRDL premium pricing chance will be much lower.
background.quote: Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult recruitment (DBL 1 for adults and DBL 2 for adols.); but the available adolescent data at DBL 1 is NOTsufficient to support label inclusion of adols (sNDA).

todo.text: Mitigation plan action #1: Submit for EC/GCP approval at existing sites; additional sites from existing site list capable of adolescent recruitment to be considered.
todo.quote:
Currently, two sites were seleced and added for adols recruitment
More sites from the exisitng site list that are capable of adols recruitment could be considered.

todo.text: Mitigation plan action #2: Engage the two adolescent sites for recruitment – proactive communication, line up adolescent patients, regular follow-up on progress/challenges.
todo.quote:

title: BI 3000202 (cGAS inhibitor, Study 1509-0004) in SLE – China Joining Global Phase II: CDE Feedback & Leading PI Selection

background.text: CDE clin-pharm division initially recommended enrolling Chinese patients in low-dose (25mg BID) arm first; team pushed back (submitted 27 Aug, alignment meeting 26 Aug). CDE accepted pushback on 29 Aug with further comment requiring detailed rationale that increased exposure poses no safety risk for Asian SLE patients in CTA.
background.quote:
CDE accepted with further comment on 29 Aug:
Suggest to comprehensively consider the available data to ensure the safety of the subjects. When submit the CTA, please provide the detailed rationale that no safety risk to increase exposure in Asian SLE patients.
